anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex curvature forming a wide-radius arc from the blowhole region to the snout base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered beak projection with a high thickness-to-length ratio relative to the cranial volume.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle at the pixel intersection of the melon's descent and the rostrum's horizontal dorsal margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Omnidirectional cyan-hued bioluminescent emission across the entire body surface with high-intensity white specular highlights on the dorsal-lateral region.
